_note: Casa sim config. Real-ish timings (realert 60, cooldown 30, hold 10) so messaging-frequency gates measure production cadence; only verify_delay (0) and check_timeout (10) are shortened - verification re-runs the check in the same sim minute, and nothing in the casa may legitimately take 45s. @RUN@ and @CASACTL@ are filled by sim/casa/up-casa.sh. alert_sink is bin/casa-sink.sh, a 3-line wrapper that pins SELFHEAL_ALERT_FILE from SELFHEAL_STATE_DIR and execs the REAL bin/send-alert.sh - needed because approve-heal.py strips SELFHEAL_* from the env of the announce sink it runs (see sim/README.md, 'known engine finding').

services.name: pihole-dns
services._note: AUTO class: DNS_DOWN restarts the resolver unasked; UPSTREAM_DOWN (degraded, WAN's fault) has no remediation and digests.
services._note_upstream: check-dns emits UPSTREAM_DOWN without severity:degraded, so without this routing a WAN outage would page as a pihole outage - the explicit notify_by_code is the template-sanctioned way to say 'chronic, not actionable here'.

services.name: truenas-smb
services._note: ASK-FIRST class with household consent: PORT_CLOSED proposes a NAS power-cycle and waits for 'heal truenas-smb'; HOST_DOWN is tell-only.

PORT_CLOSED.announce: Heads-up from Cranston: power-cycling the NAS — the photos app will blip for a minute.

services.name: truenas-disk
services._note: Capacity watch on the scripted tank volume: LOW_SPACE (degraded) digests with a DAILY nag instead of the hourly default.

services.name: truenas-cert
services._note: Expiry countdown on the generated PEM. CERT_EXPIRING is degraded (digest) above CRIT_DAYS and a full page at/below it; one daily nag either way.

services.name: plex
services._note: AUTO class with a second transport: primary 18324 + alt 18325 both answer /identity. Primary-only dead = LAN_UNREACHABLE (degraded, digest); both dead with the host pinging = SERVICE_DOWN (auto restart); host dark = HOST_DOWN (tell-only).

services.name: box-disk
services._note: LOCAL service: keeps being checked while the router is dark; capacity is scripted healthy unless a scenario fills it.
